title: fix(mcp): record data faces withhold a declared 5xx's sentence as /data does
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X1tF2sadne3zXMJh3i9wcbN)_

Fixes #31341

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:MCP 的六个记录数据工具(`query_records`、`aggregate_records`、`get_record`、`create_record`、`update_record`、`delete_record`)、`delete_records` 的选择读取和记录资源,遇到声明了 5xx 状态码的带码异常(例如 `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` / 503)时,改按 `/api/v1/data` 的回答作答:码和状态码保留,生产者原句隐去成 `Internal server error`,除非异常自己标了 `refusal: true`;原句只在服务端记一次日志。
- 为什么改:之前这些面先走"带码即拒绝"的路径,把生产者自己的那句话原样交给智能体;`/data` 门对同一异常会隐去原句。
- 风险与回滚:只改 `@objectstack/mcp` 一处判定(`dataDoorRefusalEnvelope` 里一个条件),patch。声明了 4xx 的拒绝照旧逐字节不变(#31246 的 CONTROL 钉着);未注册的码配 5xx 会像门一样落成该状态的封闭码(门把原码放在 `declaredCode`,MCP 各面都不发这个成员)。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts` 的 `dataDoorRefusalEnvelope`;`packages/mcp/src/mcp-coded-refusal.test.ts` 里两个 #31341 块。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp exec vitest run src/mcp-coded-refusal.test.ts -t 31341`,预期 11 个用例全部通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`dataDoorRefusalEnvelope` (`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts`, #31273) decides whether a coded throw on a `/data` face renders as a coded refusal or as the door's fault answer. It used to ask the door only when the throw declared no status (`serverFaultProvenance` `'undeclared'`). It now asks the door for every throw whose status is a 5xx or undeclared (`serverFaultProvenance` answers `'declared'` or `'undeclared'`), and keeps the coded answer only for a declared refusal status below 500 (`serverFaultProvenance` answers `undefined`). The predicate change is one token: `!== 'undeclared'` became `=== undefined`.

When the door (`mapDataError`, read through `dataDoorAnswerOf`) answers a 5xx, the face renders the door's `code`, sentence and `status` and logs the thrown text once through `logServerFault`, the path #31273 already built. No copy of the withhold rule: `mapDataError` applies `declaredRefusalMessage` itself. No new export from `@objectstack/types`; every reader was already imported.

All eight faces already read this one function (the six tools through `dataDoorErrorResult`, `delete_records`' outer catch, the record resource catch in `mcp-server-runtime.ts`). Only comments change in `mcp-server-runtime.ts`.

| Throw | Before (tools / resource) | Now | `/api/v1/data` (`mapDataError`) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` / 503, `'The ledger is closing.'` | code, 503, the producer's sentence | `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, 503, `Internal server error`; the sentence logged once | same |
| same, with `refusal: true` | code, 503, the sentence | unchanged | `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, the sentence |
| unregistered `VENDOR_DOWN` / 503 | `VENDOR_DOWN`, 503, the sentence | `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, 503, `Internal server error` | same, plus `declaredCode: VENDOR_DOWN` |
| CONTROL `RECORD_LOCKED` / 409 | coded | unchanged | `409 RECORD_LOCKED` |
| CONTROL coded sandboxed refusal (`RECORD_LOCKED` / 409) | coded, the body's sentence | unchanged | `409 RECORD_LOCKED` |
| CONTROL `PERMISSION_DENIED`, no status | `{ code, message }` | unchanged | `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` |
| CONTROL `SQLITE_BUSY`, no status (#31273) | the door's `500 DATABASE_ERROR` | unchanged | same |

On the resource, the same answers use its `{ error, code, status }` members.

## Tests

`packages/mcp/src/mcp-coded-refusal.test.ts`:

- Record data tools block (#31273's): #31273's CONTROL "a code with a declared 5xx keeps its coded answer" **moved**, as the order said it would. It is replaced by:
  - one row per face (7: the six tools and `delete_records`): exactly `{ code: 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE', message: 'Internal server error', status: 503 }`, equal to `mapDataError`'s answer, the sentence absent from the text, and exactly one `[5xx] 503 tools/call TOOL task — ` operator line (on `console.error` or `console.warn`) carrying the sentence;
  - `refusal: true` on every face: the sentence kept, equal to the door's answer;
  - the unregistered `VENDOR_DOWN` / 503 row: the door's closed code, sentence withheld.
- Record resource, new #31341 block: the declared 503 body `{"error":"Internal server error","code":"SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE","status":503}`, equal to the door's, one `[5xx] 503 resources/read objectstack://objects/task/records/t1 — ` line with the sentence; the `refusal: true` body keeps the sentence. #31273's resource CONTROL kept only its status-less `PERMISSION_DENIED` half; the declared-503 half moved here.
- CONTROLs unchanged and green: `RECORD_LOCKED` / 409 and the coded sandboxed refusal on every face (#31273 block) and on the resource (#31270 block), `PERMISSION_DENIED` with no status, and #31246's "a coded non-sandbox refusal renders its own message byte for byte".

The operator line is read from `console.error` and `console.warn` together because `logServerFault` reports a declared `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` as a capability absence: one `warn` per route per process, as at the door.

<details><summary>Red first and ablations</summary>

Red first on `d0512c2f` (`main`), the new pins in place and no fix: `mcp-coded-refusal.test.ts` gave `Tests 9 failed | 127 passed (136)`. The failures: the resource declared-503 row, the seven per-face declared-503 rows and the unregistered-code row. The two `refusal: true` rows passed on base, as expected (they pin the sentence kept). With the fix: `136 passed`.

Ablations, each via `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on the committed head `5c91f46f`; each printed `ok mutation landed` and then `ok restored: blob == HEAD (ebb31a2794c5) and git diff HEAD is empty`:

1. The predicate put back to `!== 'undeclared'` (the #31273 line). Blob `ebb31a2794c5 -> c9344e7ebdf1`, `Tests 9 failed | 127 passed (136)`: the same nine rows as red first.
2. The declared-refusal guard deleted, so every door 5xx is declined. Blob `ebb31a2794c5 -> c5b7abf4be16`, `Tests 1 failed | 135 passed (136)`: #31246's CONTROL "a coded non-sandbox refusal renders its own message byte for byte". Its third throw (a `SandboxError` with an empty `innerMessage` declaring `RECORD_LOCKED` / 409) is answered `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` by the door, so the guard is what keeps a declared 4xx out of this card.

The tests import the package's source, so no `dist/` is involved.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **The door, measured before the change** (`mapDataError(v, 'task')` on the built `@objectstack/types`): declared `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` / 503 answers `503 { error: 'Internal server error', code: 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE' }`; with `refusal: true`, the sentence; unregistered `VENDOR_DOWN` / 503 answers `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` plus `declaredCode: 'VENDOR_DOWN'`; declared `INTERNAL_ERROR` / 500 answers `Internal server error`.
- **An unregistered code with a declared 5xx answers the closed code.** The door names the producer's spelling only in `declaredCode`, which no MCP data or metadata face serves (`dataDoorAnswerOf` reads `code`, `error` and status only, as #31272's metadata faces do). Today that spelling reached the agent as `code`. Serving `declaredCode` here would add a member to these faces' tool error; it is not done. A producer keeps its own code on the wire by registering it.
- **A declared refusal status below 500 is not reclassified**, even where the door answers 500 for it (a `SandboxError` with an empty `innerMessage`, which the door reads as the sandbox's own fault). That is a 4xx declaration, outside this card's 5xx scope; #31246's CONTROL keeps pinning the current answer.
- **`Clause-②: no`, re-declared from measurement.** No export added or changed: `dataDoorRefusalEnvelope` is not on `packages/mcp/src/index.ts`, and the import line of `@objectstack/types` names the same symbols. The tool error keeps its keys (`code`, `message`, `status`); only the values for a declared 5xx move to the door's.
- **Not touched:** `run_action` / `resume_run` (#31271, PR #31315) and the metadata tools and `list_actions` (#31272). They never call `dataDoorRefusalEnvelope`; `thrownRefusalEnvelope`, `errorResultFromThrown` and `metaDoorErrorResult` are byte-identical. PR #31315 is still open on the same two files; whichever lands second merges `origin/main` once.
